Gold.note: Strong central bank demand and rate cut expectations support further upside.

Silver.note: Dual industrial and monetary demand driving outperformance versus gold.

Copper.note: Structural supply deficits and energy transition demand outweigh near-term macro headwinds.

Uranium.note: Structural supply deficit and renewed global nuclear capacity additions support prices.

Lithium.note: Persistent oversupply from new mine ramps outweighs steady EV demand growth.

Nickel.note: Massive Indonesian supply growth continues to swamp the market despite EV battery demand.

Zinc.note: Tight concentrate markets and smelter production cuts are supporting refined prices.

Iron Ore.note: Ongoing weakness in China's property sector limits upside despite infrastructure stimulus.

Coal.note: Structural decline in thermal demand offsets resilient metallurgical coal markets.

Rare Earths.note: Geopolitical supply risks and export controls create a premium for non-Chinese supply.

Manganese.note: Stable steelmaking demand balances ample supply from South Africa and Gabon.

PGM.note: Substitution by battery EVs pressures long-term auto catalyst demand despite supply constraints.

Potash.note: Stable global agricultural application rates support prices after the post-war normalization.

Aluminum.note: Chinese capacity caps and strong solar and EV demand tighten the supply-demand balance.

Diversified.note: Broad commodity basket provides balanced exposure to base metal deficits and iron ore stability.
